verdicts.note: Long county service, rising to chief deputy in her 2003-2007 stint, election administrator since 2023 and the county's only certified election administrator [S1]; the other finalist for the 2025 appointment [S2]. An insider running on expertise, not a new voice, but she has never held the top office [S1], so -1 rather than -2.
Appointed auditor since December 2025 by a 3-0 commission vote [S1][S2], running on her first year (payroll system, website) [S1]. An incumbent by appointment with a short tenure; -1 fits.
